unsupported: The company began as a custom poly bag and film operation, keeping every production step under one roof.
The company provides full-service custom poly bag and film manufacturing, including in-house LDPE extrusion, flexographic printing up to six colors, and bag making.

Its Los Angeles facility produces flat bags, gusseted bags, wicket bags, bread bags, ice bags, rock bags, anti-static bags, suffocation warning bags, baler bags, as well as LDPE film, poly tubing, shrink film, stretch wrap, custom sheeting, box liners, drum liners, pallet covers, furniture bags, VCI corrosion protection liners, and trash liners.
All products are made to order with nationwide shipping from the same site.

M Plastics serves a broad range of industries, including meat and protein, poultry, seafood, bakery, produce and grocery, frozen foods, food processing, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, agriculture, construction, e-commerce, retail and apparel, electronics and ESD, and landscaping.
The company emphasizes food-grade material options for food processors and manufacturers across the country.

Known for: In-house LDPE extrusion from raw resin to finished film; Flexographic printing up to six colors on any bag or film; Nationwide delivery with competitive lead times from Los Angeles facility; Family-owned and operated since 2005
